5 توحّد ٱللّٰهُ بِعِصْمَتِهِ , (S,) or توحّدهُ بعصمته, (L, K,) God protected him himself, not committing him to the care of another. (S, L, K.) ―
-b2- توحّد بَالأَمْرِ He was, or became, alone, without any to share or participate with him, in the affair. (L.) ―
-b3- توحّد بِرَأْيِهِ He was, or became, alone, without any to share, or participate with him, in his opinion. (S, L.) ―
-b4- See 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
